list: the official 55 trophies, as published 18 November 2026 (Exophase, via Push Square)
note: Guides are written in our own words for this entry. Names and descriptions are the official ones. Where no unlock method had been confirmed at launch, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.guide: The platinum is the last trophy you will earn, because it only pops once the other 54 are done. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then the one missable meditation trophy, then collectibles and activities — and keep A Long Road (100% completion) for last, since it overlaps with nearly everything else. There is no shortcut: the platinum is a record of the whole list, so use this tracker's progress bar to see exactly what is left.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!

trophies.guide: This is the opening mission, Gone Fishing, so it unlocks naturally as you start the story — just play through the intro and follow the on-screen prompts until the mission ends. There is nothing to prepare and nothing you can miss; if you are reading this before playing, the only advice is to take your time and learn the controls, because the mission also teaches fishing. It should pop the moment the mission completes.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise

trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion on the game's own checklist. This is the hardest trophy on the list and the last one most players will earn: it overlaps with the story, the stranger strands, the collectibles and the activities, so treat it as the endgame rather than a separate grind. Coverage of the launch list puts the checklist at 35 tasks, and the thresholds are reported to be lenient — roughly 60% of everything the game tracks — so you do not need literally every item in Leonida. Check the in-game completion screen often and let it tell you what is left.
trophies.name: A Long Road

trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. Stunts are the jumps, near-misses, drifts and airtime moments the game counts as you drive and ride around Leonida — they accumulate naturally if you drive fast and take ramps, but 250 is a lot, so make a habit of it: hit jumps and stunt ramps whenever you travel, and use fast bikes and cars for airtime. The counter is cumulative across the whole playthrough, so there is no need to grind it in one sitting; check your stats to see the running total.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the 9 activity types once. The list's own count is nine types — the game's activities include the shooting range, drone racing, regular racing, fishing, arcade games, bowling and meditation, among others — so the trick is variety, not mastery: do one of everything rather than repeating your favourite. Open the activities menu or map, find each type, and tick them off one by one; the trophy pops the moment the ninth type registers.
trophies.name: Master of None

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. There are 42 challenges across the range's weapons and drills, and every one needs gold, so this is a skill trophy: learn each weapon's recoil and the scoring windows, and replay a challenge until the gold threshold clears. Work through them weapon by weapon rather than jumping around, and do the ones you find easiest first to learn the range's timing. This is one of the few trophies where practice, not exploration, is the whole job.
trophies.name: The Shootist

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every one of the 14 locations. Drone races are scattered across Leonida — 14 courses in total — and you must win at each, not just finish. Learn the racing line on your first run, then push: drones reward smooth cornering and cutting gates cleanly. Work through the map location by location and mark each win; a loss costs nothing but the retry.
trophies.name: Top Fun

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. The key word is different: winning the same race twenty times does not count, so you need twenty distinct race events across Leonida — street races, off-road, boat and air races all count toward the set. Pick a fast, well-handling vehicle for each race type, learn the route on a practice run, and keep a checklist of which races you have already won so you do not repeat one by accident.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos

Fishing is introduced in the opening mission, so you will already know the basics; this is the competitive version of it.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Get a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of the search area until the stars clear. The practical way: build the wanted level in a quiet area with a fast car ready, then drive into alleys or off-road where the police lose you, and wait for the flashing stars to go out. Your partner must still be with you when the level clears.
trophies.name: Hot Together

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Rob one shop, keep the wanted level, and immediately rob two more in a row — the trick is to keep the heat the whole time, so plan a route with three shops close together and a getaway car parked nearby. Do not let the wanted level drop between robberies, and do not get caught: three in a row, partner present, stars still on.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy

trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Vehicles count as discovered when you first drive or encounter them, so variety is the goal: drive everything — cars, bikes, boats, aircraft — and visit different districts, since rare vehicles spawn in specific areas. The counter is cumulative, so every new vehicle you sit in helps; check the vehicle collection screen to see what you have found.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is the slow-motion aiming mode — activate it in a firefight with at least five enemies in front of you and drop all five before it ends. Set it up: pick a mission or gang shootout with grouped enemies, get to cover with a clear line of fire, and only trigger Combat Focus when five targets are visible. A high-capacity weapon helps.
trophies.name: Gunslinger

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA (Vice City International Airport). Get to the airport, grab a plane, and take off without a flight plan — the unscheduled part is the point: steal a plane from the tarmac or runway and get airborne. Expect a wanted level on the ground, so go in fast, board quickly, and climb before the police close in.

Rhinos are the game's tanks: they attract the military and a heavy police response, so the play is to grab one, keep moving, and use its armour and cannon to clear the road ahead. Military bases are the usual place to find one.

trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. This is a stealth job: case the store, find the quiet entry, and take the goods without tripping an alarm or being spotted — no shooting, no smashing the window in view of the cameras. Go at a quiet hour, move slowly, and leave before anyone notices; if you are detected, leave and try again later.

Five separate bank vault robberies, each ending in a clean escape — plan each one like a heist: scout the bank, bring a fast getaway vehicle, and know your escape route before you go in. The count is cumulative, so you can do them one at a time across the playthrough; the escape is part of the trophy, so do not stop running until the wanted level is gone.
